https://robheffern.palaich.net/sports/

I like sports! I like data! Combine!

This lets you see what the games on today are most similar to in the history of the sport. Click into one and see.

Also, the Sports Zodiac.

Like farmers of the olden years and the stars, we kinda set our clocks by sports these days. But what does that look like?

'Play the Years' to see a good timeline of how the years go by.

The war years, the lockouts, and the pandemic are just really easy to see in the data and quite stunning really
